## Description

Encodes asset relational graph embeddings from Graph Neural Networks into Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problems solved via quantum annealers to compute optimal nonlinear covariance shrinkage weights.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional portfolio optimization, noisy covariance matrix estimation, multi-asset risk parity allocation.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Risk-Parity Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, fundamental relational adjacency graphs, sector taxonomies.

## Caveats

NISQ hardware qubit embedding heuristics are required for large sparse asset adjacency graphs.
